name: findatagraph
description: FinDataGraph — financial data graph for continuous close & reconciliation

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @findatagraph/api & npm run dev -w @findatagraph/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @findatagraph/shared && npm run build -w @findatagraph/api && npm run build -w @findatagraph/web
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:web && NODE_ENV=production CORS_ORIGIN=* npm run start -w @findatagraph/api
scripts.eval:all: npm run eval:mcp && npm run eval:mcp-close
scripts.test: npm run test -w @findatagraph/api && npm run test -w @findatagraph/mcp && npm run test -w @findatagraph/mcp-close
scripts.dev:orchestrator: cd apps/orchestrator && PYTHONPATH=src ORCHESTRATOR_PORT=8100 python -m findatagraph_orchestrator.server
